API ReferenceZscaler Client Connector APIPublic API ControllerLists all enrolled devices of your organization and their basic details
Lists all enrolled devices of your organization and their basic details
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zcc/papi/public/v1/getDevices

Lists all enrolled devices of your organization and their basic details.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
username
string

Filter by enrolled user name for the device.

osType
byte

Filter by device operating system type.

page
int32

Specifies the page number.

Default value: 1
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. If not provided, the default page size is 50. The max page size is 5000.

Default value: 50
Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
429

OK

*/*
